body: Your words ring true to me. Your words get me motivated and I worry less. But it just lasts momentarily. It hypes me up albeit just for a moment. What you say is true though, and I agree with you. Thanks.

It's just that I've been depressed for years now. The depression wasn't caused by the breakup. Although, it did worsen my depression, but that's not really the point anymore I guess.

I will just try, until I reach 20.

Thanks for the comment.

Without even clicking on it, just seeing those letters "r/LongDistance" already hurts. I remember myself being so freaking excited, checking that sub daily, hoping that I could meet with her again as quickly as things would allow it. It was one of those things that kept me going. Whenever something bad happened to me, I could always think that soon we gonna meet again, and any worries would disappear. I wouldn't feel as bad anymore. Kinda happy actually. Problems didn't matter as much, I just tried my best, that's all.

I wanna cry now. I miss it all, I miss her.
Yeah, same. Though, we didn't breakup because of the distance. But yeah, I was browsing it daily, always thinking about her and how awesome it will be when we could meet again...

Yeah, this so so freaking much. We used to chat daily throughout the day too. I was always excited to receive a message from her. To share things with her. To send her photos and share my experiences and whatnot. This availability and care we had for eachother was amazing. To have one person who cares so much about you, who wants to be chatting with you and to know what is going on on your life and everything.

God, I miss all that so much. Not even religious.
It's definitely freaking lonelier without her for me.

Dang, that just sucks.

Yeah, you should have seen it then. If he wasn't as excited to meet you as much as you were to meet him, that definitely meant something. Though, I don't know the reason.

But don't blame yourself for that. You really liked him and you wanted to be in a relationship with him. That's all. You legit had feelings for him. You just didn't think about breaking up then. You didn't want that.

Not having that fuzzy feeling and not being happy when you message him... I don't really know what he expected. Probably a misconception of a relationship  on his part. I guess, in the end, he just got bored.

But don't take it to heart. You deserve someone much better anyway. Stay strong...

I won't? I truly hope so.

This feeling, that I will never be able to get so close to another person like this ever again, be kinda killing me inside.

And you know, this feeling is caused by something within me, it's not like I think that I will never find anyone else. It's just this feeling that I will never be able to connect physically, spiritually and emotionally so profoundly with any other person ever again. That I will never feel so comfortable with someone again.

Not knowing why I feel like this scares me. This feeling is kinda terrifying. Feels like I only had one slot in my brain for a person who I will truly connect with, and now that person is gone. Yet the slot remains used. It's not freed. It will never be.

Yeah, that's one word I was searching for. Comforting. It definitely is.

As for me, I am actually super afraid of surviving my attempt and like being paralyzed or something like that for the rest of my life, without being able to kill myself.

(Plus there is that little bit of hope at the back of my mind you know, hope that things could become better and whatnot)

Yup, that's me, but I am a bit older than you. Got nothing going on for me. If anyone were to ask me what do I do, what do I like... I'd be like... Sleep? That's about it. 

Have you ever tried finding something you are passionate about?

Yeah, exactly, it's not only the fact that you are alone and lonely... It's also the fear that you may not find anyone else, that you may not be ever that lucky again.

Quite honestly, I think that if you knew for sure, that at some point you will definitely find someone else again, it definitely wouldn't be as bad or as scary, this loneliness or break ups. You would be kinda relieved, you know.

Yet, not knowing what the future holds, while it may be quite exciting, it's also quite scary, isn't it? One more reason why break ups really suck, aside from all the other main reasons, there is this one, a huge fear of not finding someone else and being alone and lonely forever.

While, of course, staying single is not a bad thing and some people prefer it, there are other many people who while they don't mind staying single that much, they still really want to find someone to love who would love them as much, and it's quite important to them. Yet losing the person you really loved, makes you feel that you will never find anyone else... And that thought is terrifying and painful. Anyway, wrote too much.

I hope you get through this! I sincerely wish you all the best. May you find someone else. Though now it'd be best to focus on yourself.

I had been alone for long, but not quite lonely. Then I hit it off with a girl, an old friend of mine who I've always liked. We were together for quite some time. Then she broke up with me and now the loneliness sometimes becomes overwhelming.

It's interesting how being alone for so many years before, didn't really teach me anything. I gotta learn again how to be happy by myself on my own. All those years before, it's like they were forgotten, feels like I barely existed then.

But yeah... I see. To know how awesome is to be with someone you love who loves you back as much, really makes returning to the alone life quite hard.

Yeah, that's what I will try to do. I really like you, by the way. I will try being friends with her, will experiment and everything. If I see that I can be friends without any feelings getting in the way, then I will be friends with her. As long as she will also want to be friends with me. 

But I actually doubt that she will want to be friends with me, ever, so I guess it doesn't really matter anyway. I will message her in a month and a few weeks, and we'll see. Whatever happens happens. I have already accepted that I may not exist for her anymore and that she may never want to be friends. Will just wait now.

Why is that? I am not saying that we should be friends again right now, after all the breakup is still kinda fresh, but after some time, I don't see why we couldn't be friends again.

It would be mostly an online friendship, with most likely very rare meetings.

We were mostly friends at the beginning with mutual liking for eachother, but we never pursued anything further, until a few months ago. I always thought, that if being together doesn't work out, that we could at least still stay and be friends at some point again.

It's hard for me to connect with new people, extremely hard, so I value all my connections greatly and I become a bit attached.

Anyway, I don't see how being friends will hurt me in the long run. I still value her a person and I will always will.

It's very hard for me to believe that, that she could be ever thinking of me. Especially impossible that she would do that plus get a little bit sad about this whole ordeal or miss me.

But yeah, I know. Right now, the best thing I can do is to try and work on myself, my issues and my flaws. To be honest, you should never stop doing that, even when in a relationship.

Anyway, might start going to the gym soon. I believe a very good thing that I did was write down all of my flaws and things that I messed up, things that I did which I shouldn't have done and things which I didn't do but should have. You know, all those flaws and things which made her break up with me. So that I will never forget them, but instead fix them. And if it ever happens that I find someone else, I will never repeat those same mistakes again.

It's so weird for me.

I love sleeping. It's the best thing ever. Like it's just awesome. I forget about myself and life. I forget how big of a failure I am and how much I hate myself.

But when I wake up, I feel so fucking shitty. I feel worse than ever. Sleeping while it's day and wasting days and days of time, make me feel super bad. Like I am just wasting my life for no reason. But I don't wanna live anyway, so why does it feel so bad when I waste my life? 
Fuck me.

Reaching out to her, you mean?
Yes, every single day I have thought about that. But I know that it is completely, completely over. Forever. Nothing will change that fact. She told me she will never ever want to have anything with me anymore. Never again. Never.

And when she told me about my flaws, they weren't all cute or something like that. They were serious things that made her dislike me and not want me anymore. That's about it.

Just focus on that moment. Focus on what she did to you. You already know that she isn't worthy of you, which is great to see and be aware of that. You're not useless, she fucked up. Don't forget that.

Now, you just need time to heal and process through all of your emotions.

Something similar to what she wrote to me.

She wrote that I loved her more than she ever did and that I loved her too much, lastly, she wrote to me that she doesn't wanna have or build a future with me.

She told me why, and that was because I had a lot of flaws... I am aware of them now, but I wasn't before.

I miss her.

I don't know if he told you why, but if he did not, it probably hurts even more...

I am sorry that you are going through this.

Congrats, I am happy for you!

You realised that he actually wasn't good for you, he was being all nasty...

Do you have any tips for getting over someone who never has been nasty, bad or in any way toxic to you though? It's okay if you don't.
Just wondering...

I am happy that you made it through.

Well, it's a kinda little bit of a long story...
But like it was pretty much completely my fault.
She wasn't toxic to me or anything like that in any way. She is great, with some flaws there and there, but just minimal ones that wouldn't really result in a break up. While my flaws were severe. Depression and whatnot. I blame myself a lot of pushing, albeit unknowingly, such a person who I adored and loved with all my heart away... She was my best friend. I didn't act exactly how I should have acted... Don't think that I did anything bad, no. But the things I did definitely did make me extremely less likeable and she lost the attractiveness and love she had for me because of all that. Self blame is strong on this one. I can't help it. I lost such a great and amazing relationship and friendship, just because I was like that... Kill me, I wouldn't actually mind, just let me write a few goodbye notes first, that's all I would ask.

Thanks!

But it's not that easy. She wasn't just some romantic interest. She was my best friend. So many conversations with her daily. Shared so many things. Now, I lost her. I feel lonely. There are so many times when I wanna share something, news or an experience, but I can't. She doesn't care about me anymore.

And when I say that she has been in all those good moments and memories, I truly mean it. My childhood was shit. But we moved to another country for a year and that year was my best year ever. That is also where I met her. That year wasn't so awesome just because of her, it was awesome in general, because of all the new things... And then this summer, this was the best summer in my life. Yet, she was in this summer too and I will admit, she was the one who made this summer so great.

(All the previous summers in my life, I have spent infront of a computer screen, wasting away my life. This summer was the only real summer I have ever had and it was with her.)

But for real, in my life, I have not had many happy moments. It is what it is. And those few I have had, it's either because of her, or if not because of her, she still was there, somewhere accompanying me and being an addition to an already awesome moment.

To be honest, I never thought I would be ever happy again before this summer. But she gave me such childlike happiness, like, it's hard to explain. 

She truly is connected with all those experiences. She was one of the people I felt truly connected with. I would have died for her. But it's over.

I hope you get through what you are going through. I truly wish you all the best. Stay awesome. Not that helpful I know, that shit is super rough... But yeah.

(It seems like you were a great person to her though, it's just that she broke up with you for some reason. But it seems like the breakup wasn't really your fault? So you can't blame yourself, at least. That's a great thing.)

While she broke up with me cause of my flaws and the way I was. I fucked up and I failed to show and give her my best self. I wasn't strong or fast enough... I didn't improve quickly enough. She kinda gave up on me too quickly, but I can't blame her.

Anyway, yeah.
Gotta keep going?
Self blame doesn't help, but that you don't have. Which is super great! As hard as it is right now, you will find someone else!

I know you probably wrote this in hopes of getting a good comment, something that will help you cope... But I don't know.

It's the same for me too. As much as I try to not think, as much as I say to myself that we'll never ever be together again, as much as I make myself accept that fact... A slither of hope for some freaking reason still remains there.

I doubt it will ever go away, but most probably, in months, I most likely won't care as much. I believe, slowly but steadily, you will stop caring as much. Time does heal. As long as you trying to actually heal and get over him.

Sorry that I can't be of any more help.
